name: Ecommerce Leads
description: Official hosted server for Ecommerce Leads. Looks up any ecommerce store by domain without an account: estimated revenue, marketing budget, traffic, Google and Meta ad spend, ad counts, a Conversion Rate Score and buying signals. Searching 600k+ stores, revealing contacts (spends credits) and managing signal sets and watchlists need OAuth 2.1 on the same endpoint.
author: Ecommerce Leads
